column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a16 -- a15 with the fix of the first frontend translation of a15 (fe170h refused the lower
# module: "assignment value has unknown type" at a struct field access passed as an argument, lower.lm2:21314:63, the next field of the
# found field): the four field accesses passed as arguments in the new lower functions are cast as the modules do (the next field of the
# found field cast to a field pointer in lm_compiler_emit_lifted; the elem_ty and kind fields of both path steps cast to int in
# lm_compiler_whole_applicable). The a15 fixes (fe170g refused the helpers module, "node is a word of the language"): the locals and
# parameters named node in the five new functions renamed at, the local call of lm_compiler_merge_lift_find renamed appl. The a14 fix:
# a duplicated condition line (an empty if) in lm_compiler_whole_decide removed. The a13 fixes: the LIFTED and DEFERRED marks moved to the
# frame flag bits 65536 and 131072, merge rejected as a call head by lm_compiler_lift_call_head, the hidden declaration name allocated
# zeroed and no trailer written on the hidden body, the four helper functions exported in tools/build.lm2 (frontend_names 264). The
# remainders of the review of Codex over a11 (a12): the hold of the overlapping readings (whole_overlap_held), the names and the form
# of a whole call before the actual in both executors (lmx_call_bind_whole_form), the merge written in the call itself lifted into a
# hidden declaration (THEN operand 66, OP_COUNT 67), the applicability by the Consumer-relative projection with the conversion table.
